name: Hidamari no Kioku
source:
Tatsuya Kinoshita quit going to school because of a bully.
He became a fragile shut-in (hikikomori) who might never get past the damage.
The only person that gave him a reason to keep living was Hinata, a girl he knew his knew his whole life,
and the only one who treated him like a true friend before and after the bullying.
But she gave her heart to the bully that drove him to this life... 

[from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE126633.html]DLsite English[/url]]
